answer.book: Two works in one volume: Nicolaus Mulerius's treatise on the Jewish and Turkish/Arabic years (Groningen 1630), with dedication, reader's address, indexes, calendars, chapters I–XVI and a second part on the Arabic and Turkish year, followed by the Historia Arabum of Rodericus Toletanus, chapters I–XLVIII, printed back to front with descending page numbers.
